findings.title: Fallback catalogs are not loaded for translations outside controller requests
findings.body: The translation accelerator only lazy-loads `config.locale`. The new fallback backend then searches `SiteSetting.default_locale` and `:en` directly inside the backend, bypassing `I18n.translate` and therefore bypassing this loader. `ApplicationController#set_locale` works around this for HTTP requests by explicitly loading the whole fallback chain, but mailers, background jobs, model validations, and any other server-side `I18n.t` caller do not run that filter. In those contexts a missing translation in the active locale will still be reported as missing rather than being resolved from the configured fallback locale.

findings.title: No tests cover the custom fallback chain with lazy-loaded translations
findings.body: This introduces a custom fallback implementation plus explicit catalog loading, but the change contains no regression tests for resolving a key missing from a user locale through the site default and then English. Tests should exercise the translation accelerator as well as request and non-request contexts; otherwise failures caused by fallback catalogs not being loaded, incorrect fallback ordering, or locale-setting changes will not be detected.
